memory: I believe the key to successful leadership in finance is fostering a culture of excellence while maintaining humanity and empathy. By empowering my team members, holding them accountable, and fostering sustainable growth, I've seen remarkable results at Legend Investments. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and I encourage everyone to challenge conventional thinking. My open-door policy ensures that even our junior analysts feel comfortable sharing their insights.
